features.name: Frequent free spins

review:
A desert oasis with a neat scatter counter: a scale beside the reels fills with water as scatters land, showing how many dropped each spin.

Three, four or five scatters trigger free spins, with the potential for 33 or more and unlimited retriggers. And they come round very often – roughly once every 57 spins, the most frequent bonus we list. Medium-high volatility, a 1,939x cap and an excellent 97.13% RTP. Great for long demo sessions.
pros: Excellent 97.13% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 57 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
